reason_templates.same_body: Two shapes are fixed within the same URDF link; not a relative collision degree of freedom.
reason_templates.same_fixed_island: URDF fixed joints make these links one rigid assembly; internal envelope overlap is not an articulated collision query.
reason_templates.exact_neighbor_arm_meshes: Only the two vendor arm link meshes joined by this exact arm joint share a bearing/interface. Attachments on either link are not excluded by this rule.
reason_templates.wheel_chassis_assembly: The cylindrical drive-wheel envelope rotates in its fixed chassis wheel well. This assembly-interface exclusion does not hide arm/tool-to-wheel pairs.
reason_templates.wheel_ground_rolling_contact: Intentional tire/ground rolling contact is outside robot collision-clearance diagnostics; no wheel-ground contact-dynamics validation is claimed.

scope: Pose-wise conservative geometric separation of the declared envelopes. Nonpositive means overlap or unresolved separation, not measured penetration. No physical, continuous-path or braking certificate.
